pages.text:
The Seed Extractor threshes crops into their seeds, for replanting and for the Oil Press. It uses 10 FE/t and takes 5 s per crop.
| Crop | Seeds |
| Wheat | 2 Wheat Seeds (50%: a third) |
| Beetroot | 2 Beetroot Seeds (50%: a third) |
| Melon Slice | 1 Melon Seeds (50%: another) |
| Pumpkin | 4 Pumpkin Seeds (50%: a fifth) |
| Sorghum Stalks | 2 Sorghum Seeds (50%: a third) |
| Hop Cones | 1 Hop Seeds (25%: another) |
| Flax Fibre | 1 Flax Seeds (25%: another) |
Speed and Energy upgrades work.
